notes: MECHANICALLY LOCKED SHAFT: the brake is never released. Hand-derived before the first run: omega stays 0 (the brake switch's R_on leaves at most ~1e-7 rad/s); the winding is an LR circuit, i -> V/R_tot = 6/2.05 = 2.92683 A with L/R = 2.44 ms; no back-EMF, so all input becomes winding heat. The brake holds the torque surplus: the torque it APPLIES to the shaft is tau - K i = 0.0392266 - 0.878049 = -0.838822 N m. Distinct from hoist-balanced-hold, where the shaft is FREE and stays still by torque balance.
